title: Gulf Meridian Bank Q.P.S.C. outlook revised to negative
body: Ratings agency Gulf & Crescent revised the outlook on Gulf Meridian Bank Q.P.S.C. to negative from stable, citing a decline in the bank's CET1 ratio to 12.1% from 13.4% a year earlier and pressure on profitability. The long-term issuer rating was affirmed at A-.

title: Gulf Meridian Bank outlook revised to negative on capital decline
body: Gulf & Crescent revised the outlook on Gulf Meridian Bank to negative from stable, citing a decline in the bank's CET1 ratio to 12.1% from 13.4% a year earlier and pressure on profitability. The long-term issuer rating was affirmed at A-.

title: Gulf Meridian Bank FY2023 results: CET1 falls to 12.1%
body: Gulf Meridian Bank reported full-year 2023 results with a CET1 capital ratio of 12.1%, down from 13.4% at the end of 2022. Net profit fell 8% year on year. The bank guided to stable margins and said it continues to evaluate its capital plan.

title: Gulf Meridian group treasurer departs
body: Gulf Meridian announced that its group treasurer, who led the bank's funding and capital management, has left to pursue other opportunities. The bank said a search for a successor is under way and that the deputy treasurer will serve in an acting capacity.

title: Gulf Meridian board approves USD 1.5bn EMTN programme update
body: The board of Gulf Meridian Bank Q.P.S.C. approved an update to its euro medium term note programme, increasing the programme limit to USD 1.5 billion. The bank said the programme provides flexibility for senior and capital issuance, subject to market conditions.

title: Gulf Meridian USD 500m sukuk matures in May 2025
body: Gulf Meridian's USD 500 million sukuk, issued in 2019, matures on 14 May 2025. The bank has not announced refinancing plans for the instrument. Its AT1 notes also have a first call date in September 2025.

title: Gulf Meridian mandates banks for senior bond
body: Gulf Meridian Bank has mandated a group of banks to arrange a senior unsecured bond under its EMTN programme. This is the outcome event the positive episode is built to predict; signals must fire before this date to count as lead time.

title: Northern Harbour Bank reports steady FY2023 results
body: Northern Harbour Bank reported full-year 2023 net profit up 3% year on year, with a CET1 ratio unchanged at 14.9%. The bank reaffirmed its outlook and said it expects no material change to its funding plan.

title: Northern Harbour Bank declares ordinary dividend
body: The board of Northern Harbour Bank declared an ordinary cash dividend in line with its established payout policy. No changes to capital plans, leadership, or funding programmes were announced.

title: Northern Harbour Bank outlook affirmed at stable
body: Gulf & Crescent affirmed Northern Harbour Bank's issuer rating at A with a stable outlook, citing consistent capital levels and predictable earnings. No rating drivers changed.

title: Gulf Meridian Capital Partners closes private credit fund
body: Gulf Meridian Capital Partners, an independent asset manager unaffiliated with Gulf Meridian Bank, closed its third private credit fund at USD 400 million. The firm is not a bank and has no public debt programme.
